name: GradientPicker
description:
A gradient built on ColorPicker: linear, radial or angular, with stops along a rail. Drag a stop,
press the rail to add one, or use Add stop and the Position field, which need no drag. Each stop
is a slider: arrow keys move it (Shift for ten percent), Home and End go to the ends and Delete
removes it. The rail follows the gradient's own axis, left to right in every language, as the
colour picker's axes do. The value is `GradientValue`; `gradientToCss` turns it into CSS, and the
preview shows that same string, in sRGB, so it looks the same on any display.
signature: ({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onValueChange, kinds, maxStops, alpha, swatches, eyeDropper, disabled, locale: localeProp, labels, className, id, "aria-label": ariaLabel, "aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledBy, }: GradientPickerProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: alpha
props.description: Offer opacity on each stop (`#rrggbbaa`). Default false.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the picker group when no visible label names it.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that name the picker.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting gradient when uncontrolled. Default: a mid blue to a pale violet.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: eyeDropper
props.description: Offer the browser's eyedropper where it has one. Default true.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: kinds
props.description: The types to offer, in order. Default all three.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ picker: string; preview: string; kind: string; linear: string; radial: string; angular: string; angle: string; stops: string; stop: (number: string) => string; stopValue: (position: string, color: string) => string; position: string; addStop: string; removeStop: string; mostStops: (count: string) => string; fewestStops: string; }> | undefined

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: maxStops
props.description: The most stops a gradient may hold. Default 8.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the gradient when a change is finished: a stop or colour drag released, a key, a typed number. A drag only repaints until then.

props.name: value
props.description: The gradient. Pair with `onValueChange` to control it.
